scientific_integrity.assumptions: Five distinct branch points and characteristic exactly three.
scientific_integrity.claim_scope: Smooth ordered genus-five Humbert–Edge curves over algebraically closed characteristic-three fields, and normalized branch configurations rational over finite extensions.
scientific_integrity.proof_evidence: Multiquadratic Galois cover, five elliptic quotient characters, an isogeny killed by 8, the characteristic-three Legendre Hasse invariant, and uniqueness of harmonic completion of a triple.
scientific_limitations: Parameter counts are not abstract curve-isomorphism counts.
Does not provide full zeta functions or classify non-split branch configurations.
No assertion for coincident branch points or other characteristics.
An unindexed overlapping calculation may exist.

title: Characteristic-three rank rigidity for genus-five Humbert–Edge curves
